verdict.rationale: No first-party doc describes native custom fields or editable workflow statuses. The only product-side signals are community reports that monday.com 'required too much setup and customization' and has an 'un-opinionated style' that bends to managers' processes. Developer-built board column types (monday-docs-44) are an apps-framework building block and earn no credit. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of native custom fields/columns, configurable status labels and workflow states, and hands-on corroboration specific to fields and statuses.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can customize fields and workflow statuses to match my team's process

citations.quote: it required too much setup and customization, similar to Jira
its un-opinionated style made it quite crappy. You basically have to do whatever all the managers came up with randomly
